Apart from numerals it gives a fixed ~0.45 on the FIRST '.' or line break of a text (later ones, '!' and '?' stay near 0.1) and 0.25-0.65 on third-person narration of objects, places and events (a place preposition or verb after a concrete noun: 'lay by the door', 'over the hills', 'would be closed') and on a copula or 'has/had' right after an opening pronoun ('I was', 'She is', 'We had'), but it stays below 0.25 at any length on first- or second-person statements of liking, opinion, feeling, wishes, advice or thanks that contain no numeral, no '.', no line break, no 'so' and no opening pronoun + copula ('I really like the new album and I think every song on it is great', 'You did a fantastic job on the presentation and everyone loved it'), and on German text.
